cards.card_text: His drinking cups are gold, silver counts as nothing, and every three years the ships of Tarshish come in with gold, silver, ivory, apes and peacocks.
cards.verse_text: For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
cards.snippet: …the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.

cards.card_text: Now come his riches: 666 talents of gold a year, shields of hammered gold, cups of gold and an ivory throne overlaid with pure gold, like nothing ever made for any kingdom, while the ships of Tarshish bring in ivory, apes and peacocks.
cards.verse_text: For the king had the ships of Tarshish that went with Hiram’s servants, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
cards.snippet: …the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
